purpose: Fixed descriptive in-sample scan; not a prediction attempt or candidate registration
fair_null: Independent periods; uniformly sample six unordered mains from1..49, then special uniformly from the remaining43; retain actual dates
exact_two_sided: Sum null PMF masses no greater than the observed mass, including relative tolerance1e-12
multiple_testing: Single BH family over all1373 tests, no within-group-only correction; also report BY sensitivity; strictly q_BH<0.05 only as Astra-review findings

exact_tests.single_gap: 49 exact longest-zero-run tests for69 Bernoulli(6/49) periods; probability-ordered two-sided; include observed boundary zero runs, not inferred pre/post-window gaps
exact_tests.tail_counts: 10 exact69-fold convolutions of Hypergeom(49,tail_size,6); digits n mod10; sizes4 for0,5 otherwise
